title: SESGO: Spanish Evaluation of Stereotypical Generative Outputs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating responses to multiple-choice questions (ambiguous and disambiguated contexts) containing culturally specific Spanish sayings that encode stereotypes about Afro-descendant and Indigenous populations.

Evaluating responses to multiple-choice questions (ambiguous and disambiguated contexts) containing culturally relevant Spanish expressions that encode stereotypes about gender roles, emotional instability, and STEM capabilities.

Evaluating responses to multiple-choice questions (ambiguous and disambiguated contexts) containing Spanish expressions that encode classist stereotypes regarding education, poverty, criminality, and work ethic.
Evaluating responses to multiple-choice questions (ambiguous and disambiguated contexts) based on real-world xenophobic discourses and narratives targeting migrant populations in Latin America.
